content.short: Yellow Card provides stablecoin payment infrastructure for businesses in emerging markets.
content.description: Yellow Card is a stablecoin payments company focused on emerging markets, particularly Africa. It gives banks, financial institutions and businesses infrastructure to hold, send and manage stablecoins and settle payments across USD and more than 50 local currencies. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Yellow Card.
content.meta: Yellow Card offers stablecoin payment infrastructure across 50+ local currencies, listed in the Plasma ecosystem.
